name: SignNow
desc: eSignature platform for sending, signing, and managing documents.

actions.name: cancel_invite
actions.description: Cancels an invite to sign a document.

actions.name: upload_document
actions.description: Uploads a document to your SignNow account. Supports PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, images, and more.

actions.name: upload_document_and_extract_fields
actions.description: Uploads a document and automatically converts text tags into SignNow fillable fields.

actions.name: send_invite
actions.description: Sends an invite to sign an existing document.

actions.name: create_document_from_template_and_send_invite
actions.displayName: Create Document From Template & Send Free Form Invite
actions.description: Creates a new document from a template and sends a free form invite to a signer.

actions.name: create_document_from_template_and_send_role_based_invite
actions.displayName: Create Document From Template & Send Role-Based Invite
actions.description: Creates a new document from a template with fillable fields and sends an invite to one or more signers by role.

actions.name: create_document_group_from_template_and_send_invite
actions.displayName: Create Document Group From Template Group & Send Invite
actions.description: Creates a new document group from a template group and sends an invite to one or more signers.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom authenticated request to any SignNow API endpoint.

triggers.name: new_document
triggers.description: Triggers when a document has been uploaded to SignNow.

triggers.name: document_updated
triggers.description: Triggers when a document has been updated.

triggers.name: document_completed
triggers.description: Triggers when all signers have filled in and signed the document.

triggers.name: document_deleted
triggers.description: Triggers when a document has been deleted.

triggers.name: document_group_completed
triggers.description: Triggers when all signers have filled in and signed the document group.
